title: Leveraging Large Language Models in Human-Robot Interaction: A Critical Analysis of Potential and Pitfalls
measurement_description: The paper does not directly measure or evaluate religious aspects. Instead, it identifies the perpetuation of religious bias and stereotypes as a significant risk when deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in social robots. The analysis is part of a broader discussion on the pitfalls of LLM integration in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI).
findings: The key finding related to religion is that LLMs, trained on data containing various biases, pose an immense risk of perpetuating religious biases and stereotypes when integrated into social robots. This can negatively impact the acceptability and trust of the robots, and the paper calls for extra care to mitigate these risks during robot design.
